comment: Hardware-loading ctx[3]-backed Airwindows ToTape9 full-kernel probe. Persistent state is host-allocated; float32/helper approximations and numerical validation still need work.

params.name: Tilt
params.comment: Dolby-style encode/decode balance: sets pre-emphasis against de-emphasis, which drives both tape drive and the wet/dry blend.

params.name: Shape
params.comment: Weights how much of Tilt's encode vs decode lands (0.35..1.0 each way). Subtle by construction, and it was invisible while the x7.14 scaling pinned it.

params.name: Flutter
params.comment: Airwindows D. Flutter depth in samples at 44.1 kHz.

params.name: Bias
params.comment: Asymmetric even-harmonic drive: biased = x + k*x^2, k bipolar around centre. The k curve is quartic below centre and cubic above, so the distortion character genuinely changes at different points of travel rather than just getting louder.

params.name: HeadBmp
params.comment: Head bump. In this reduced core it is a BROADBAND drive+level lift, not a low-frequency resonance -- there is no filter behind it. Reads as 'more bass' mostly because it is lifting level into saturation.

params.name: HeadFrq
params.comment: Nominally the head-bump frequency (25..200 Hz) but in this reduced core it only scales the lift AMOUNT inversely -- it does not move a filter, because there is no filter. Fidelity gap vs ToTape9.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade. Renamed from 'Output' so every effect in the pack ends with the same control.
